profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Software developer with 8+ years of experience building and modernizing enterprise web applications in ColdFusion, CFWheels, JavaScript, and Microsoft SQL Server. Track record of hardening legacy codebases against security risk, improving database performance, and using AI-assisted engineering to automate development workflows. Comfortable owning a feature end-to-end, from requirements through deployment.
